respuesta.pregunta: What kind of database does order-workflow-api rely on, and what does it keep in it?
respuesta.respuesta:
I only found documentation for one version of order-workflow-api, 5.6.2-hotfix-1, so there are no other versions to compare against. In that version, the service uses a MySQL database [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/README.md:L40-L40]. It stores two things:

- The workflow configuration, such as protected branches and releasable branches [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/README.md:L42-L42].
- The schedule for creating versions automatically [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/README.md:L43-L43].

The README points to the Database page for more detail [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/README.md:L45-L45].
